findings.title: Client is fully authoritative: no server trust boundary exists
findings.recommendation: Keep deferred while guest-only. Before any cloud/account mode, add a server-side validation boundary and re-audit. Re-confirm the dated acceptance in docs/README.md.

findings.title: master is unprotected: no required PR, review, or status checks
findings.recommendation: Enable a master ruleset: require a PR, require the CI status check, require CODEOWNERS review, block force-push and deletion. Verify by attempting a direct push.

findings.title: The `release` environment required by release.yml does not exist
findings.recommendation: Create the `release` environment with required reviewers and restrict it to v* tags, then verify a non-maintainer tag push waits for approval.

findings.title: CI is failing on master at the audited commit
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to a Next.js line that bundles postcss >= 8.5.19 (or a validated override), or mark the audit step as an explicit, non-blocking risk-acceptance with a linked register entry so the workflow result is meaningful.
findings.note: partially-fixed: draft PR #35 (remediation/buddy-CI-P1-001) adds a root npm overrides.postcss pin to ^8.5.28, so the copy under next is patched; the CI security gate is green on the PR. Verified-fixed only once merged to master.

findings.title: Inventory item actions mutate the store but are never persisted
findings.recommendation: Persist after applyItemAction (call saveGame with version 2, guestId, buddy, inventory, createdAt/updatedAt), exactly as the other two screens do.

findings.title: dependency-review job is skipped because the dependency graph / Dependabot is disabled
findings.recommendation: Enable Dependency graph + Dependabot alerts/security updates in repository settings; verify the dependency-review job then reports a real conclusion.

findings.title: Inventory item actions are not written to the save
findings.recommendation: Call saveGame after a successful applyItemAction, using the same pattern as MainDevice and AdventureScreen.

findings.title: README states the stack is Next.js 14 but the repo is Next.js 15.5.27
findings.recommendation: Update the README stack table to the actual pinned major.

findings.title: README 'Known gaps' and testing sections contradict the current code/tests
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the README with the current code: mark achievements/evolution/skills wired, and update the testing section to list existing suites.

findings.title: No backup/restore drill and no committed evidence of one
findings.recommendation: Add a restore drill to the release checklist: export a representative save, clear storage, import, and assert equality; record the artifact per release.

findings.title: Save export uses btoa and can throw on non-Latin-1 content
findings.recommendation: Encode with TextEncoder + base64 (or encodeURIComponent/unescape) and decode symmetrically in importSave; add a test with a Unicode nickname.

findings.title: High-severity postcss advisory remains in the production dependency tree (accepted)
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Next.js to a line bundling postcss >= 8.5.19, or validate a root override; otherwise keep RA-001 current and re-check monthly and at expiry.
findings.note: partially-fixed: root npm overrides.postcss pin to ^8.5.28 validated in draft PR #35; RA-001 closed in docs/RISK_ACCEPTANCE.md. Verified-fixed only once merged to master.

findings.title: Repository secret-scanning and Dependabot security updates are disabled
findings.recommendation: Enable Dependency graph, Dependabot alerts + security updates, and secret scanning with push protection in repository settings.

findings.title: Vendored prompt pack authorship and licensing are unconfirmed
findings.recommendation: Confirm author/holder and license, or remove the pack from the distribution; record the decision with an owner and date.

findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline' scripts and styles
findings.recommendation: Move to a nonce/hash-based script-src when Next.js supports it, or record the exception with an owner and revisit on the Next.js major upgrade.

findings.title: Inventory actions are lost on reload (persistence gap visible to the player)
findings.recommendation: Persist on every successful item action; optionally show the autosave status like MainDevice.

findings.title: Pinch-zoom is disabled (viewport maximumScale=1, userScalable=false)
findings.recommendation: Remove maximumScale/userScalable (or set userScalable true and allow zoom to at least 5x).

findings.title: AdventureScreen mutates a state object in place instead of returning a new one
findings.recommendation: Return the incremented progression from applyAdventureResult (or spread into a new buddy) rather than assigning to the returned object.

findings.title: Exploit-chain surface is limited to save import; residual risk is client respawn
findings.recommendation: No action required while guest-only. Re-run this lens after any server/account introduction.

findings.title: `next lint` is deprecated and will be removed in Next.js 16
findings.recommendation: Migrate to `eslint` CLI (or the codemod) before upgrading Next.js.

findings.title: applyAdventureResult mutates item objects shared with the input inventory
findings.recommendation: Map to new item objects before incrementing quantity.

findings.title: [SEC] gitleaks not installed (secret scan skipped)
README quality-gate command omits the build step used by CI
findings.recommendation: Document the gate CI actually enforces (lint, typecheck, test, coverage, build).

findings.title: No feature-flag or plugin boundary for content/feature evolution
findings.recommendation: For future content velocity, add a typed content-loading seam and a minimal feature-flag config; not required for the current RC.

findings.title: Vendored prompt pack dominates the repository tree
findings.recommendation: Decide: keep under a submodule/archive with confirmed license, or move out of the product repo.

findings.title: No .editorconfig; line/format policy is split across tools
findings.recommendation: Add `.editorconfig` and, optionally, a pre-commit format check.

findings.title: Documented release/CI controls drift from the live repository configuration
findings.recommendation: Add an automated settings check (gh api) to CI or a runbook step, and reconcile the docs with actual settings.

findings.title: No incident-response runbook or tabletop exercise recorded
findings.recommendation: Add a short IR runbook (token compromise, bad release rollback, dependency emergency) and run one tabletop; store the record under docs/.

findings.title: Manifest relies on SVG icons flagged maskable; no PNG/apple-touch fallback
findings.recommendation: Add PNG 192/512 and a maskable PNG (with safe zone), plus apple-touch-icon and manifest id.

findings.title: Service worker caches all runtime responses without a storage budget
findings.recommendation: Bound the cache and handle QuotaExceededError on cache.put.

findings.title: Client errors are only logged locally; no production error sink is wired
findings.recommendation: Attach a privacy-respecting reporter to `buddy:error` (no save contents), or explicitly accept 'no production telemetry' in the risk register.

findings.title: Install-prompt detection polls on a 1s interval
findings.recommendation: Replace polling with the `beforeinstallprompt` event (already listened for in lib/offline/sw.ts) and store the captured event in the store.

findings.title: No in-app privacy notice or data-management surface
findings.recommendation: Add a small settings/about surface with export, delete, and a short privacy notice.

findings.title: Service worker caches every successful same-origin GET with no bound or eviction policy
findings.recommendation: Restrict runtime caching to immutable hashed assets, bound the cache, and use stale-while-revalidate for navigations.

findings.title: No automated backup of the browser-local save
findings.recommendation: Provide a periodic export/backup affordance (or File System Access download) and document recovery steps.

findings.title: No license policy and no committed SBOM artifact
findings.recommendation: Define an allow/deny license policy and enforce it in CI; optionally commit the per-release SBOM (or link the artifact) and resolve the LICENSE decision (SUPPLY-P1-001).

findings.title: gitleaks runs with the default ruleset; no reviewed allowlist file in-repo
findings.recommendation: Add a reviewed `.gitleaks.toml` allowlist (or a documented false-positive registry) and use it both in CI and in deterministic runs.

findings.title: Guest id falls back to Math.random in non-secure contexts
findings.recommendation: Keep as documented. Ensure fallback is never used as an auth/ownership token if a server is added later.

findings.title: Coverage scope excludes components/ and app/; no E2E or accessibility automation
findings.recommendation: Add component/app files to the coverage scope (or a second threshold), and either add E2E + axe checks or remove the unused Playwright dependency.

findings.title: Selling an item has no confirmation step
findings.recommendation: Add a confirm step for sell, or an undo window.

findings.title: Install prompt and offline banner can overlay content
findings.recommendation: Reserve space or make the indicators dismissible, and test on a 320px viewport.
